## Design

### 2026-10-13 – ![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/ed6d64ffa548232c4b9e807818440b9abb79536c1b986584b2fd7f176bf6337a.png)

**3h**

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/ed6d64ffa548232c4b9e807818440b9abb79536c1b986584b2fd7f176bf6337a.png)
Today I started this week's project, the Desk Organizer. I spent some time planning what it would look like and I also did some research in to drawer mechanisms, looking for one that would work for me and wasn't too complicated. I couldn't find anything so I decided to make my own. I spent a while trying to design a drawer mechanism that was easy to make for me while also being detachable and rigid. It took most of my time. This is what I came up with:
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/21e71f7874c9f1675a98a920b5c41b7b5a551b8a229aeb61a912aa87361c993b.png)

I'm not a hundred percent sure it will work and I have to do a but more testing and experimentation but for now it'll do. I also decided on these measurements for the the whole build: 24x16x12. I do have to also find a way to make this whole thing without wasting too much filament, which I also need to do.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/e635b3294ea2c869552981071398dc99961974d2db9b847abf5c3ec5b5dbb0ad.png)
This is what I have so far.

### 2026-10-15 – Today I continued working on my CAD project. Today was mainly focused on fixing problems and optimising the structure for 3d printing.

**5h**

Today I continued working on my CAD project. Today was mainly focused on fixing problems and optimising the structure for 3d printing.

This is what I have so far, and yes it doesn't look much different but I changed a few things. The first thing I did was add the top drawers.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/05613e9cb651bd138c73687b0ce3d917c7722b1cf7be66901a9092d980ce924f.png)

I also found out that there was a major flaw with the drawers. I wanted to test the drawers to see if they worked, which was a really good call because I found the flaw. There wasn't enough  clearance. in the drawer rail, and the hole to connect the drawer into was too small. I spent some time fixing those 2 problems, and the drawer rails seem to be working (I hope so).

I also added a coin piggy bank kinda thing to the build. I haven't made the collection door for it yet,  but I have made the compartment.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/471badbc27cb04080eb49a762d69a89d0a579a193447ed05ed6f1789bc557a87.png)

The biggest thing I did today was optimizing for 3D printing. The case for the whole thing alone (without the drawers) came out to 700g of filament, and the supports took more than 150g of filament too, which was waay too much, along with the fact that the supports would be impossible to clean. I sized the build down by 87.5%, which helped alot, but the supports were still there.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/c624f8ab9b7bcfa35340a071647532e472314e9034b818f131b022b2b4047740.png)
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/74a7f25745ba9cf8e57021bcaa89847eeec1f0f80388e6e31437e9d04f672da8.png)

So now I had to find a way to make the build more efficient, and after a while, I came to the conclusion of printing it on its back, and printing the top face separately. Then I had to do a bit more optimization for the drawers and the pen holder, which was a nightmare. Now the pencil holder has a separate detachable divider instead of the inbuilt one. This is what the bottom half will look like:
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/744800698fb07e134256016b90920ba3d1641029e0ef9b1a6687fefb9f1dc5ee.png)

This brought the amount of filament needed drastically.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/e303f803ac736bb81a5688177b621fdb086e040c8c119ec0fa8729dcc664ab3b.png)

tl:dr, I finished the drawers, did some major drawer fixing,  added a coin safe, and did some optimization for 3d printing.

### 2026-10-17 – Today, I finally finished my project. I made a few little improvements, fixed a few small things, and got the amount of time and filament the print will need.

**4h**

Today, I finally finished my project. I made a few little improvements, fixed a few small things, and got the amount of time and filament the print will need.
This is what I've got, and I would say its not bad for an inexperienced CAD user.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/ae526ba1825efc2c74f54573d0fbfa2ede54d79a62cbe15dab3c52e267adb887.png)
I added some grates or whatever they're called to the pencil holders so the front doesn't look too plain.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/473f1541022b8a129e49693d6b0d20ecd2c5f51b661105e52028ba393ea6721d.png)
I also added small openings in the drawers to make them easier to open.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/1e22eae63f456e03d815f124d403ecb57da06c504ca6bcd0f1026713c134ed6e.png)
What took the most time today though was making a pivot door for the coin piggy bank i made last time. I had to get a bunch of measurements right and it was frustrating. I accidentally didn't make enough clearance, which I realized last minute, so great save. Its not perfect, since I made the design myself, but I'm hoping it'll at least work.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/d8ba095cd36d0d0f013b7a1d8ffe2339c75a44dd73de3d24d767906a2e24dc61.png)
Now all I have left is to find a place to print the thing. I'm thinking about buying a roll of filament and printing it at my library, which is my main idea, but I'm also looking at printing with hack club's printing program Legion. (Edit: I'm probably not doing that cuz of shipping costs.)
These are the prints details:
Total time: 14h 36m    Total filament: 579g
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/cb15b8d58c356b6cc58eed96c5ed01a2b6d8a8cd1e9f77942345ec4786c68685.png)
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/7045d647f5328149ceedcc5f2fec5a65d778fdd96920f233c7060948c45a19a4.png)
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/22ffd4ba1e78cba05b2673d83fbd87796481a0e501f470dac36e7482e96e21da.png)

So yeah, I just need to update my repo and BOM and I'm done. Fun project this week that I learnt a lot from!
